# A2CR

A2CR is an MCP-first context relay service for AI agents.

Primary site: https://a2cr.app/
Public guide (Japanese): https://a2cr.app/guide
Public guide (English): https://a2cr.app/en/guide
Pricing: https://a2cr.app/pricing
MCP endpoint: https://a2cr.app/mcp

Use case:
- Save compact WorkBaton checkpoints before an AI agent conversation gets too long.
- Resume a saved slot from another window, model, or MCP-capable client.
- Use MCP tools instead of guessing direct HTTP API endpoints.

MCP setup:

Codex TOML example:

```toml
[mcp_servers."a2cr"]
url = "https://a2cr.app/mcp"

[mcp_servers."a2cr".http_headers]
Authorization = "Bearer <A2CR_API_KEY>"
```

Generic Streamable HTTP JSON example:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "a2cr": {
      "type": "streamable-http",
      "url": "https://a2cr.app/mcp",
      "headers": {
        "Authorization": "Bearer <A2CR_API_KEY>"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

Agent rules:
- Do not save secrets, API keys, Authorization headers, private database URLs, full transcripts, or long logs.
- Save goal, current_state, next_action, and compact supporting facts.
- In a new window, first call resume_context(slot_name="...") or resume_context(slot_number=N).
- If candidates are returned, choose from the candidates instead of guessing.
